properties.description: PantherClaw OCSF events, one per record, into PantherClawOCSF_CL. A record is one entry of an export batch's data.events: no transformation splits a batch.

dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated = datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(time) * 1ms
| project TimeGenerated, Ocsf = pack("class_uid", class_uid, "class_name", class_name, "category_uid", category_uid, "category_name", category_name, "activity_id", activity_id, "activity_name", activity_name, "type_uid", type_uid, "time", time, "severity_id", severity_id, "severity", severity, "status_id", status_id, "status", status, "status_detail", status_detail, "message", message, "metadata", metadata, "actor", actor, "api", api, "src_endpoint", src_endpoint, "authorizations", authorizations, "user", user, "entity", entity, "finding_info", finding_info, "finding_info_list", finding_info_list, "resources", resources, "unmapped", unmapped)
